strata_selection.note: an absolute rating floor, not a tercile of the pool: the same seed must name the same corpus whatever fraction of Test.zip is unpacked. Licensed by the pilot's pi_hat ~ 0.04 for this band - a proxy for the paper's pi bands, not a measurement of pi, see scripts/build_strata.py

criterion: a program is selected if it catches >= 0.67 of the scoreable natural mutants caught; the corpus is frozen only if >= 90/120 programs passing
usability_criterion: test data present; reference passes its own cases; the faulty version is refuted by the shipped pool; neither version times out
selection: every task is drawn from the hard band alone - AtCoder rating >= 1600, 188 coding tasks in the pool, shuffled with seed 20260717; at most one fault per coding task; the gate is measured on the first 120 stage-1 survivors (120 passed), and the corpus is topped up past that cohort until 120 passing programs are held
